name: Request information about specific animal species and their characteristics
description: Users asked for factual information, classifications, and comparisons regarding specific animals, including their physical traits, behaviors, evolutionary history, and ecological roles. The requests ranged from general species descriptions to specific details about breeding, diet, and survival capabilities, as well as queries about fictional creatures from video game franchises.
